description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 music video prompt with attached video evidence from @ou_zhen599.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3音乐视频提示词。

prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 15-second, 16:9, cinematic photoreal image-to-video sequence based on <Picture 1>. Preserve the exact same young female explorer throughout: same face, proportions, wet skin realism, hairstyle, clothing, body ratio, chest and waist silhouette, and performance identity. Keep the entire video inside the same collapsed ancient temple main hall shown in <Picture 1>: the same hall depth, skylight opening, strong side-back volumetric beams, humid dusty air, sparse drifting embers, scattered rubble, hanging thick rope, and giant stone idol altar ahead. Do not leave this hall, add other chambers, add extra people, or cut to black. The visual tone is elegant, sensual, dangerous, and tightly narrative, with sensuality coming only from force, breath, danger, and sculpted light during motion rather than posing. The camera stays physically close to her action path: intimate near-body glide in the first half, then over-shoulder follow and slow push in the second half, with only one very short forceful match cut at the final reversal to the beast eye extreme close-up. [Shot 2] At 00:00-00:02, she is already suspended mid-swing in the first frame, gripping the thick rope with her main hand. Start on the gloved hand, wrist, forearm tension, shoulder strap load, collarbone, upper chest breathing, and upper torso under strain, then glide to her face while she surges forward through dusty humid air. Her body forms a dangerous arc: both legs tucked back, pelvis and spine curving with the swing, shoulder back muscles, collarbone, chest, and core all under real load. Her face is in hunter-like target lock, not performing to camera. Pupils are sharply focused, upper lids narrowed, gaze pinned to the altar ahead, brow center drawn inward only a little, nostrils open from controlled short breathing, lips closed with a tight natural line, lower lip showing a tiny breath tremor, jawline locked cleanly, and neck-side muscles moving subtly with effort and breath. Wet hair strands whip back in the backlight. She murmurs in a low breath-close voice: <d>[English] There you are.</d> [Shot 3] At 00:02-00:04, stay on the same action axis and follow her swing-dive from a close slightly low position. She cuts through the cold skylight beam and suspended dust, using her core to correct trajectory while rope, shoulders, and back control the travel line. The giant idol altar opens ahead with clear spatial readability. Her emotion shifts from target lock into imminent strike decision: the gaze narrows further, becomes harder and more precise, the eyeballs track the relic position, brow tension deepens slightly, one mouth corner tightens almost invisibly, breathing deepens into a preparatory inhale, the throat moves lightly, and the head tips forward a little like final calibration before a dive attack. The camera remains smooth and intimate. [Shot 4] At 00:04-00:06, she passes the idol altar at speed. One hand snaps out and seizes the relic embedded in a recess of the stone idol while the other hand yanks the rope to redirect momentum. The grab must read with exact hard physics: finger closure, wrist torque, forearm tension, shoulder engagement, and a fast believable pull free. The relic emits a restrained but clear local cold-gold or cool amber glow as it leaves the socket, illuminating only her palm, knuckles, lower jaw edge, lower lip edge, and a small patch below the collarbone. Her emotion enters razor focus with a trace of suppressed acquisition thrill: eyes locked on the relic, blinks reduced, upper lip tightening, lower lip controlled under load, cheek line and jawline sharper, no broad expression, only concentrated force and compressed near-success charge. Fine stone dust and tiny chips fall from the empty recess under gravity. [Shot 5] At 00:06-00:08.5, her body drops into landing. The toe grazes the floor first, then the boot sole scrapes through grit, thin dust, and scattered stone fragments. One knee dips, pelvis and shoulder line are tugged off center by inertia, then she catches and controls the slide immediately. Keep the chain continuous and readable: seize, rope-pull, descend, toe-skim, scrape, slide, stabilize. Hair, straps, clothing edges, belt pieces, and small hanging gear all show slight delayed swing and return. As she stabilizes, she lifts her eyes for a fast scan, first ahead, then back to the stone idol. Her breathing grows one beat heavier, lips part slightly as if to release air, then close again. Her emotion turns from sharp success into rapid confirmation and renewed alertness: a tiny lift at the brow peak, the sense of “got it, keep moving.” [Shot 6] At 00:08.5-00:11.5, she turns immediately and retreats half a step without stopping, pressing the relic tight to her rib side with one hand while the other rises into a defensive balancing posture. Her center of gravity stays low, ready to spring again. The camera stays half a step behind her left side, then eases into an over-shoulder relationship with the idol without crossing axis. The tempo slows slightly to let the abnormality bloom. The stone idol begins to change: first a low inner resonance, then surface dust falling, tiny grit trembling and hopping, then hairline cracks extending along the real stone grain, not as a glowing graphic but as physical fracture progression. Her emotion shifts from controlled motion to instinctive alarm while still moving: pupils contract slightly, the eyes widen only in a predatory-alert way, the brow center tightens again, the nostrils pinch for one beat as the breath catches then release, the lips part as if she is about to speak but suppresses it, the jaw locks harder, and the side neck muscles stand out. She does not freeze; she perceives danger inside retreat. [Shot 7] At 00:11.5-00:15, over her shoulder, the camera slowly pushes toward the idol face. In the crack there is first only a line of wet cold reflection, then a living beast eye gradually resolves from the dark interior, damp and organic, with a tiny sharp reflective point on the surface. The pupil makes one slight constriction and holds directly on her. In the final two seconds, perform one extremely short match cut from the shoulder push-in to an extreme close-up of the beast eye, making this the only hard visual nail in the sequence. She retreats only half a step more but does not flee. Her head lifts slightly and her gaze is pinned. Her final emotion is cold recognition after suppressed shock: pupils tighten then steady, eye corners hold tension, the brow stops deepening and freezes into a controlled guarded position, lips part naturally for the line, mouth shape stays restrained and realistic, then after speaking only the faintest downturn at the corners and a suspended breath remain. She says quietly, <d>[English] This isn't treasure.</d> The first half carries a tiny pause of dawning realization; the second lands lower, colder, and more solid. End on the suspended stare between her and the beast eye, with dust, moisture, and tiny particles still moving inside the same main hall. Do not cut to black.

overall_soundscape: Maintain a temple interior bed throughout: hollow stone reverb, rope friction under load, distant fire crackle, occasional tiny falling debris, boot scrape on stone, dust dragged across the floor, low architectural resonance, humid air movement, and sparse realistic embers. Emphasize rope strain, close breathing, fabric and strap tension, air split by her swing, hand impact on the relic, stone scrape, fine chips falling, toe contact, boot scrape through grit, gear settling, low inner stone resonance, dust drops, faint crack propagation, and her tightening breath. Keep the hall quiet but pressurized in the final section, with slow crack settling, faint wet inner reflection presence, suspended breathing, tiny falling stone particles, and her cold low line <d>[English] This isn't treasure.</d> No loud drums, no bombastic score, no extra voices, no exaggerated monster roar.

non_diegetic_music: Keep music minimal and secondary to the environment. Use only a thin low-frequency suspense bed under the temple acoustics, almost subliminal in the first half, tightening slightly after the relic is removed and the idol begins to resonate. Do not swell into action music or horror stingers. End on unresolved low pressure and suspended threat.
